description.zh: 截图的最大数量。默认值：**1**。
description.en: The number of snapshots to capture. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 截图高，取值范围：`[8,4096]`，默认原片高，单位：px。
description.en: The height of the snapshot, in pixels (px). Valid values: `[8,4096]`. The default is the height of the source video.

description.zh:
截图的间隔时间，必须**大于或等于0**。
- 单位：秒。
- 默认值：**1**。
- Interval为**0**时，表示按照Count数根据视频时长平均截图。
description.en:
The interval for capturing snapshots. The value must be **greater than or equal to 0**.

- Unit: seconds.

- Default value: **1**.

- If you set `Interval` to **0**, the system captures snapshots at even intervals based on the video duration and the value of `Count`.

description.zh: 自定义 ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一。
description.en: A custom ID that can contain lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The ID must be 6 to 64 characters long and unique per user.

description.zh:
截图模板ID。
- 推荐先创建截图模板，再传递截图模板ID。截图模板创建详情，请参见[添加截图模板](~~99406~~)。
- 如果传递截图模板ID，会忽略除Action、VideoId之外的请求参数。
description.en:
The ID of the snapshot template.

- We recommend creating a [snapshot template](~~99406~~) before you specify its ID. For more information, see [AddVodTemplate](~~99406~~).

- If you specify `SnapshotTemplateId`, the system ignores all other request parameters except for `Action` and `VideoId`.

description.zh:
截图指定时间的起始点。

- 单位：毫秒。
- 默认值：**0**。
description.en:
The start time for capturing the snapshot.

- Unit: milliseconds.

- Default value: **0**.

description.zh: 指定视频时间点进行截图，单位：毫秒。一次可指定最多30个时间点。
description.en: An array of specific time points in the video to capture snapshots. Unit: milliseconds. You can specify up to 30 time points.

description.zh: 生成雪碧图的配置信息。如果不为空则生成雪碧图。参数结构详情，请参见[SpriteSnapshotConfig ](~~86952~~) 。
description.en: The configuration for generating a [sprite](~~86952~~). If you specify this parameter, the system generates a sprite. For more information about the parameter structure, see [SpriteSnapshotConfig](~~86952~~).

description.zh:
自定义设置。仅支持JSON字符串，支持用户自定义数据透传及指定回调地址设置等。参数结构详情，请参见[UserData](~~86952~~)。

> 此参数中消息回调的使用前提是需要在控制台配置HTTP回调地址和勾选对应的回调事件类型才能使用，否则回调设置不生效。
description.en:
Custom settings in JSON format. This parameter allows you to pass custom [user data](~~86952~~) and specify a [callback URL](~~86952~~). For more information about the parameter structure, see [UserData](~~86952~~).

> To use the message callback feature, you must first configure an HTTP callback URL and select the corresponding event types in the console. Otherwise, the callback settings will not take effect.

description.zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the video. You can obtain the video ID in one of the following ways:

- Log in to the [ApsaraVideo for VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.

- Get the VideoId from the response to the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation. This operation provides the upload URL and credentials.

- After a video is uploaded, get the VideoId from the response to the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation.

description.zh: 截图宽，取值范围：`[8,4096]`，默认原片宽，单位：px。
description.en: The width of the snapshot, in pixels (px). Valid values: `[8,4096]`. The default is the width of the source video.

descriptions.zh:
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027551~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[获取任务详情](~~2861326~~)主动查询任务状态。
- 暂时只支持生成JPG格式的图片。
- 截图完成会产生EventType=SnapshotComplete,SubType=SpecifiedTime的[视频截图完成](~~57337~~)的事件通知。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342790~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027551~~). After you submit a job, a job ID is returned. The job is then queued for asynchronous processing. The final result is sent via a [callback notification](~~2861326~~). You can also call the [GetTask](~~2861326~~) operation to query the job status.

- Currently, only snapshots in JPG format are supported.

- When a snapshot job is complete, the system generates a [SnapshotComplete](~~57337~~) event notification with `EventType=SnapshotComplete` and `SubType=SpecifiedTime`.

### QPS limit

This operation has a limit of 30 queries per second (QPS) per user. The system subjects calls that exceed this limit to [rate limiting](~~342790~~), which may impact your business. Plan your calls accordingly. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342790~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod submit-snapshot-job --video-id d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --specified-offset-time 0 --width 1280 --height 720 --count 1 --interval 1 --sprite-snapshot-config CellWidth_:_120,_CellHeight_:_68,_Columns_:_3,_Lines_:_10,_Padding_:_20,_Margin_:_50 --snapshot-template-id f5b228fe693bf55bd87b7890000 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://.example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_example_:_www --specified-offset-times 1000 --reference-id 123-123 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vod SubmitSnapshotJob --region cn-hangzhou --VideoId d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --ReferenceId '123-123' --SnapshotTemplateId f5b228fe693bf55bd87b7890000 --UserData 'MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://.example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_example_:_www' --SpecifiedOffsetTimes '[1000]' --Height 720 --SpecifiedOffsetTime 0 --Count 1 --SpriteSnapshotConfig 'CellWidth_:_120,_CellHeight_:_68,_Columns_:_3,_Lines_:_10,_Padding_:_20,_Margin_:_50' --Width 1280 --Interval 1
